sections.content: Combine regular and common irregular pretérito indefinido forms to recount a completed festival experience. Use sequencing words to make the order clear and include details about people, places, food, music and traditions.

items.english: First we went to the festival.

items.spanish: Por la tarde estuvimos en un concierto.
items.english: In the afternoon we were at a concert.

items.spanish: Al final celebramos una tradición local.
items.english: In the end we celebrated a local tradition.

sections.content: When you retell a whole day, the irregular forms like *fuimos* and *estuvimos* tend to mark the big turning points — arrival, the main event — while regular forms carry the smaller details in between.
